groups.text: Robots: bot swarm run and MuJoCo on the CAD meshes

runs.name: swarm run (body model)
runs.cfg: 1,024 bots on an unseen shape (the lizard emoji), body model (assumed, motion limits measured in MuJoCo): one line per bot, noisy sensing, 30% packet loss. Four copies: no damage, cut off, squashed, scrambled; damaged at step 32, then left alone. ag_axis_mlph_scales2.

runs.name: roll + quarter-turn gait
runs.cfg: one bot from rest: a roll (left) and the validated turning gait (right); simulation, flat-disc feet
